newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Life reports 1996 earnings gain.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Life reports 1996 earnings gain.

text.p: Swiss Life/Rentenanstalt said that its premium income for 1996 rose 15 percent to 10.06 billion Swiss francs from 8.75 billion in 1995.
It also said that 1996 parent profit rose 21 percent to 1.37 billion francs from 1.13 billion in 1995.
It said that 98 percent of its earnings, or about 1.35 billion Swiss francs, would be placed in bonus reserves for policy holders.
For 1996, it will pay an unchanged dividend of 7.00 Swiss francs per participation cerficate, it said.
It said its results reflected mainly positive developments on financial markets, which allowed it to increase technical provisions.

Swiss Life said in January that it planned to convert to a public company from a cooperative company. It will register itself as a listed company on June 30 providing it gains majority approval of its cooperative members.
